3 x Wall_4m_H6, 5 x Wall_4m_H4, 3 x Wall_4m_H3 + 1 x Wall_2m_H3, EndR_H3 at y 44 into the hill; the foot steps are hidden by the bank (bank crest 1-1.5 m above the water, rising upstream)
